findings: RULE 15 leg (a), one-way leak: the stance set supplies the proposition that the proposal is to put up charging outlets for cars, surviving in 4 of 4 options, and the other prompt, 'Vad sägs om kallelsen?', supplies no context whatsoever. Joint stems-only floor as an independent product: 0.33 times 0.30 equals 0.10 against a 6.25 per cent base, a lift of about 1.6 times

Joint stems-only floor correlation-adjusted: no single proposition decides both items, since the stance item turns on rhetorical shape and the notice item on form isolation. With no shared decider the adjusted figure stays near 0.10 to 0.12 rather than rising
The honest reading is the independent product, because the two questions are decided by unrelated considerations and modelling them as one commitment would overstate the exposure
justification: Neither RULE 15 leg fires decisively. Joint floor about 0.10 against a 0.0625 base. Pair passes.

findings: RULE 15 leg (a), one-way leak: the shape set supplies an open-air roofed floor with an exposed perimeter across 3 of 4 options, through 'taket vilade på en stolpe mitt på golvet', 'spelmännen' and 'så att det rann av utanför golvets brädor', and the railing item needs exactly that world. RULE 15 leg (b), symmetric vouching: each set independently rebuilds the same shared variable, an open-air roofed dansbana with an exposed perimeter, one set through 'utsatt' and 'syns utifrån' and the other through roof, musicians and rain. Joint floor correlation-adjusted: both blind picks are the option explaining a feature by what the dancing needed, so one interpretive commitment decides both. Conditional on that reading being right the joint approaches 0.50, and conditional on it being wrong both items fall together

The honest reading here is the CORRELATION-ADJUSTED one, about 0.50, because the two picks are not independent draws but a single reading of the text applied twice, so the independent product materially understates the exposure
justification: Both legs fire on setting rather than on the key, but the two items share one interpretive decider, so the honest joint floor is about 0.50 against a 0.0625 base. Pair flagged; the kill already sits on the shape item.
